verdict.rationale: Quo's official MCP server and its one-click Claude/ChatGPT connectors let users manage conversations, contacts, call history, voicemail transcripts and missed calls in plain English, and send texts by asking. The documented natural-language scope covers only messaging, contacts and call data, not the wider product such as routing, phone menus, number setup or workspace settings, and all evidence is vendor-claimed. missing for 10: natural-language control over call routing, phone menus and workspace or number configuration, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that the plain-English operation works as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Connect Quo to any agent and manage your conversations, contacts, and call transcripts in plain English. No coding required.
One-click connectors for Claude and ChatGPT, plus a public MCP server and an API your own agent can read and act on.
Send a text to one person or broadcast the same message to multiple team members from your Quo number, without opening your workspace.
Search your contact list, look up a specific contact’s details, add new contacts, or update existing ones just by asking.
Get info about your missed calls to your Quo numbers, and see their voicemail transcripts directly from your chat.
